critical_code_review_comments: The load-on-open useEffect at lines 363-372 of AssignmentCreateDrawer.jsx is now correctly sequenced AFTER the reset-on-open effect (line 342-361). React same-component effect ordering guarantees the reset runs first, so pendingDraft is hydrated against a pristine form — exactly the safety property the comment claims.

Both branches handled correctly: when open transitions false->true, _readDraft() is called; when open transitions true->false, pendingDraft is reset to null. The cleanup branch is important because it prevents a stale draft modal from flashing if the drawer is re-mounted without remounting the component tree.

Discard flow is doctrinally clean: prompt vanishes, localStorage purged, form stays pristine, user-visible 'Draft discarded' toast confirms the action. Restore flow is equally clean: prompt vanishes, note repopulates from the saved payload.

The 14-day TTL purge is a quiet/silent path (no toast, no UI flicker) — appropriate, the user shouldn't see a 'we threw away your old draft' message they didn't ask for. The localStorage cleanup is the right behaviour.
Minor (carry-over from prior review, still applies): DRAFT_KEY and DRAFT_TTL_MS could be hoisted to module scope to avoid re-creating on every render. Purely cosmetic, not a bug.
